scope: Space stable first implementation batch; not full module acceptance
implementation: Independent Context creation and name/description editing
Category / Space / optional Group creation and editing
Separate Context SQLite data root; public registry retains locations and creation stages only
Multiple unverified addresses with names/notes/purposes and optional main address
Owner-validated API/Role/Agent references, tool selection and enable/disable
Original intent replay, revision conflicts, unknown results and conservative pending handling
Permission scope match, commit/return rechecks, per-object projection filtering and immutable command/query inputs
Cooperative root leases, confirmed shutdown, strict persisted format and corruption rejection

evidence_layers.domain: injected trusted-host permissions and owner ports; explicitly test fixtures
evidence_layers.storage: real shared SQLite, close/reopen, independent-process readback, multiple directories, injected commit failures
evidence_layers.real_dependencies: shared storage and root locks; real permissions local refusal verified

not_completed: Placement / multiple organization placements: unresolved model, no implementation
Workspace directory registration and existing-Context attach/index rebuilding
Context config patches beyond name/description and reserved empty config
Destructive deletion, automatic migration, cross-Space moves and cross-root alias guarantees
General manual reconciliation/resume for prepared mutations with unconfirmed apply: retain unknown, never auto replay
Production local-entry authorization and App/IPC positive integration
Fresh data-root initialization: host must supply pre-existing initialized roots
Real API/AI owner ports: only injected contract fixtures available

rulings.decision: Keep Context body and all selections in its own namespace; public data root only contains organization and registration facts
rulings.basis: space README 4.1-4.3; shared Store only guarantees one-namespace transactions

rulings.decision: Bind business-intent hash to complete trusted operation scope and input intent; serialize original request and result with aggregate
rulings.basis: prevents receipt replay across distinct target/capability scopes; duplicate same-scope changed input rejects

rulings.decision: Require existing host-initialized roots and shared cooperative leases; never invent root identity or initialize a missing directory during query
rulings.basis: current shared/app public capabilities; avoid silently claiming startup/UI path is integrated

rulings.decision: Ordinary prepared-but-unconfirmed mutation remains unknown on replay; Context creation can finish ready registration after observing matching committed body
rulings.basis: do not repeat uncertain effects; no cross-directory atomicity claim
